title: Why does it rain?
hook: Hello friends! Drip, drop, splash! Where does rain come from, and why does it fall?
answer: The Sun warms water on the ground, and some of it floats up into the sky as an invisible mist. High up, the air is colder, so the mist turns back into tiny drops that make clouds. The drops bump together and grow, like little snowballs. When they get too heavy to float, they fall as rain.
wowFact: Here is a wow fact! The rain falling on you today might be the same water a dinosaur splashed in long, long ago!
experiment: Try this! Ask a grown-up to help you put a cup of water on a sunny windowsill. Mark the water line. Look again tomorrow. Did some water float away?

onScreenText.experiment: Try it: watch water vanish from a cup

description: Bolt follows a drop of water from the ground to the clouds and back down as rain. Then he sets up an easy cup experiment to see water disappear into the air.
